title: Chronos Ledger
tagline: High-throughput distributed event streaming and audit log engine with deterministic replay.
overview: Chronos Ledger is an append-only event store designed for financial and operational microservices requiring strict ordering, cryptographic tamper evidence, and sub-50ms query latency across partitioned streams.
architectureOverview: Events are ingested through stateless edge workers, sequenced via partitioned write-ahead logs, and asynchronously projected into read-optimized PostgreSQL materialized views.

takeaways.challenge: Hot partition contention during burst traffic spikes exceeding 15,000 events per second.
takeaways.solution: Implemented adaptive shard key hashing with bounded in-memory batching, reducing write lock contention by 78%.

takeaways.challenge: Slow state reconstruction when replaying long-lived aggregate streams.
takeaways.solution: Introduced automated rolling snapshots every 500 events with zero-downtime background compaction.

title: Vanguard Flags
tagline: Zero-latency feature flag evaluation engine and real-time telemetry control plane.
overview: Vanguard Flags enables engineering teams to decouple deployment from release using deterministic percentage rollouts, cohort targeting rules, and instant kill-switches synchronized globally.
architectureOverview: Rule definitions are compiled into compact JSON ASTs in the control plane, replicated to Redis edge caches, and streamed to connected SDK clients over Server-Sent Events (SSE).

takeaways.challenge: Inconsistent bucketing across web and backend SDKs during gradual percentage rollouts.
takeaways.solution: Standardized on a unified MurmurHash3 specification with shared cross-language conformance test vectors.

takeaways.challenge: Stale flag rules when network connectivity drops between application nodes and the control plane.
takeaways.solution: Built a local disk-backed fallback snapshot store with exponential backoff reconnection on SSE streams.
